title: Version integrity, derived locks, and preservation
acceptanceCriteria: Correction, cancellation, concurrency, unauthorized mutation, lineage, source preservation, and approved-current aggregation pass end-user scenarios.

personasEvaluated.summary: Verified correction opening preserves is_auto_summary and B01 contract metadata, derived operational rows are locked against direct mutations across all API channels, and authorized rebuild refreshes derived rows cleanly while preserving management opinion.
Verified separation of duties (preparer cannot self-approve), approved versions lock and cannot be rebuilt, and cancellation of a correction restores original approved version.

Verified multi-source provenance (2 of 2 sources) is cloned and remapped losslessly to revision child row UUIDs, and activity master log counts only current approved version, preventing double-counting.
Verified read-only viewers can inspect reports by date without edit permissions, while anonymous and cross-project users are blocked with 401/403.

deliverablesVerified: A.1.03 (Daily report revision integrity and derived locks)
verificationSummary: Requirement B02 meets all acceptance criteria. All 6 historical QA defects (DEF-B02-01..06) are completely resolved in the active codebase. Derived operational rows are immutable, provenance is preserved across revisions, official activity logs strictly filter by is_current=True, and rebuild correctly validates target eligibility with localized FA/EN error messages. Frontend typecheck passes with 0 errors.
